faq.descripcion: Key information and answers to the most common inquiries regarding software development and engineering services.

q1.pregunta: What are the primary technologies used for Full Stack development?
q1.respuesta: Development is built upon the Microsoft .NET ecosystem (.NET 9, C#, ASP.NET Core Web API, EF Core, Dapper) for robust, high-concurrency backend architectures, complemented by Next.js 15, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS on the frontend for modern, fluid, and SEO-optimized web interfaces.

q2.pregunta: How is the project workflow and communication structured?
q2.respuesta: Projects are managed using agile methodologies with planned sprints. Regular progress updates, staging environment demos, and direct access to management boards and source repositories are established to ensure full operational transparency.

q3.pregunta: What are the estimated delivery timelines for an application or system?
q3.respuesta: Timelines vary depending on technical scope and complexity. A modern website or institutional landing page is typically completed in 1 to 2 weeks, whereas an enterprise management platform or custom MVP (.NET + Next.js) is structured in bi-weekly sprints over 4 to 10 weeks with continuous deliverables.

q4.pregunta: How are code quality, architecture, and engineering best practices ensured?
q4.respuesta: All software engineering adheres strictly to SOLID principles, Clean Architecture, and clear layer separation (Repository, Service, Controller). Automated testing is implemented across critical flows alongside thorough technical documentation to guarantee long-term stability and maintainability.

q5.pregunta: Are server configuration, domain setup, and cloud deployments included?
q5.respuesta: Yes, solutions are delivered fully operational and turnkey. The scope encompasses complete infrastructure: custom domain mapping, SSL certificates (HTTPS), production database provisioning (PostgreSQL/SQL Server), and automated cloud CI/CD pipelines (Vercel, Azure, VPS, or Docker).

q6.pregunta: Is it possible to intervene in existing systems or modernize legacy codebases?
q6.respuesta: It is entirely feasible to either start greenfield projects or integrate into existing systems. Services include codebase audits, database query optimization, legacy refactoring, and migrating monoliths toward modern decoupled APIs.

q7.pregunta: What warranty and post-launch technical support is provided?
q7.respuesta: Every project includes a post-launch technical warranty period (15 to 30 days) to address adjustments at no additional charge. Ongoing feature evolution and proactive maintenance retainers are also available to support system growth.

q8.pregunta: Who retains intellectual property rights and repository access?
q8.respuesta: 100% of the intellectual property, source code repositories (GitHub/GitLab), software licenses, and server/cloud credentials belong exclusively to the client upon formal project delivery.

q9.pregunta: What engagement and contracting models are available?
q9.respuesta: Engagements are available as fixed-scope projects (with defined deliverables, milestones, and timelines) or via time-and-materials / sprint allocations for continuous development and technical architecture consulting.

q10.pregunta: How are payment terms and invoicing structured?
q10.respuesta: Agreements are coordinated through clear, transparent payment milestones (typically 50% upfront and 50% upon approved delivery, or per bi-weekly sprint). Tax invoices are issued, and local as well as international bank transfers are supported.
